key_findings: Orexin B dose-dependently ameliorated CCI-evoked neuropathic pain in rats.
Orexin B reduced microglial activation, IL-6, TNF-alpha, iNOS, COX-2, NO and PGE2 and blocked JNK/NF-kB activation in the spinal cord.
